datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Burundi to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for each month of 2021, capturing medium-term projections of food insecurity phases across administrative units.
